title: Wagon band battles and playing soft
summary: Ory rode an automobile truck to catch other bands and played softly to draw crowds.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did you run into other bands sometimes when you were advertising?
Oh. Huh? That was my main house. What happened? Tell them. Well, we were fighting until we wanted to get tired of bands. Tired looked like I always went out.
Did you ever go out looking for the other bands? Oh, yeah. Yeah?

I paid extra, you know. I was the first one advertising the automobile truck, you know. So we could catch the other band. In case the horses, they couldn't get out of the way, you know. Ha ha ha. It was lots of fun, you know. Yeah. Most of the band, they'd just blast and play loud, you know, all the way through, you know. We'd get on the corner and have an introduction, you know. And come down, it's all good. People just run out the house and gang riding the wagon and start to dance, you know. That's that song. And you could hear them talk, play it, kid. Oh, yeah. Oh, boy. Dancing on the street.

Yeah. Yeah. Well, they liked writing, not just blasting all the time, you see. Swinging. Well, they couldn't hear it way off, you see, and they'd get close, you see. Bring them through me with sweetness. But you probably had plenty of rhythm. Huh? Oh, yeah. Well, you could hear everything, but it wasn't blasting.
My idea is to never lose the rhythm. Yeah. Yeah. But bring it down soft so that they gather around and really start to listen.
